approval.scope: one new AI-assisted formal-pilot outdoor root frame only; no Cocos, no WeChat, no build, no upload, no Git

generation.input_reference_role: B style reference for mood, value hierarchy, material and high-level spatial grammar only; not an edit target and not a production pixel source

normalization.operation: center-cover resize to 780x1688, add a fully opaque alpha channel, attach sRGB metadata, and normalize PNG encoding; no retouching, repainting or segmentation

rgb_equivalence_check.note: Adding the opaque alpha channel changed no visible RGB byte.

owner_preflight.decision: Continue from this master candidate without spending the single targeted edit yet, but keep formal 20-layer production blocked after the transparent-layer probe failed.
pass_reasons: Adult and ordinary cat read as shared back-view stargazing companions.
Deep-indigo mature comic material, dry-brush linework, halftone and broad value masses are aligned with approved B direction.
Exactly one broad pale broken Milky Way, exactly two weak glowing flowers, and no text, UI, meteor or task-map marks are visible.
known_risks: The house and warm door are deliberately small and quiet; later branch invitation UI must preserve the sky-first hierarchy while keeping the door hittable.
The cat is slightly large but still reads as an ordinary domestic cat; do not enlarge it in future frames.
This is still a flat master candidate. It does not prove honest 20-layer reconstruction, alpha quality, ORA packaging, Cocos readiness, or phone performance.
The first transparent-layer probe returned RGB with a painted checkerboard and background ghosting, not a usable alpha layer.

layer_probe.conclusion: Do not continue producing the remaining nineteen layers with the same method. The formal layer package remains blocked.
